about_the_game:
The goddess of vanity has issued you a dangerous challenge. Win, and you rescue your imprisoned companions; lose, and you are stripped of your humanity to become a plaything in her hands. Life and liberty are at stake—will you beat her at her own game?

Cubic Cosmos brings you a unique roguelike deckbuilding experience, where tower-defense gameplay and fast-paced, hard-hitting card battles collide to create unparalleled strategic depth.

Fight Fate With Every Choice

Choose to wage war or explore random events—every step could change your destiny.

  • 200+ cards with dozens of possible strategic combinations.

  • 50+ relics, each one crucial to your deckbuilding strategy.

  • 50+ random events.

  • Complete runs to unlock various heroes with unique strategic abilities.

Build an Unbeatable Deck

Pair relics with cards to enjoy deep strategic deckbuilding gameplay.

  • Dozens of Strategic Combinations: Focus on powerful pawns, deadly sorceries, or mysterious relics. Shield your pawns from harm, or let their death strengthen your forces... the possibilities are endless!

  • Lasting Improvements: Cards can gain permanent increases to their attributes through a variety of methods. Through constant improvement, even the weakest of pawns can become powerful warriors.

  • Chain Reactions: Cards have unique effects that can set off a deadly cascade of skills—sit back and watch the show!

Share the Challenge, Share the Glory

Record and share your battles, and climb to the top of the rankings!

  • Record Your Battles: Generate run seeds and battle codes to share your finest moments and relive your greatest fights!

  • Climb the Rankings: Receive 'likes' from other players for incredible performances and fight your way to the top!

  • Help Your Friends: Share your battle code to help your friends and receive aid in return. Synchronize your progress and witness the power of friendship!

short_description: Cubic Cosmos is a roguelike deckbuilder which combines fast-paced card battles with unique tower-defense gameplay. Build up your deck, construct your strategy, unlock heroes, and encounter random events. Forge your unique path ahead with every step you take!
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
